mcp_tools.name: home_shortlist_carrying_cost_comparison
mcp_tools.title: Home shortlist carrying cost comparison
mcp_tools.description: Submits a home-shortlist carrying-cost comparison record (criteria declared before search, candidate home records, declared monthly carrying-cost components, tracking and ranking) and returns a deterministic HOME_SHORTLIST_COMPARISON_READY / HOME_SHORTLIST_COMPARISON_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across five sections, including recomputed per-home carrying-cost totals, spread and budget-coverage figures, with per-check evidence. Compares the declared figures; it fetches no listings and values no homes.

inputSchema.description: The home-shortlist comparison manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

search_name.description: Name of the home search / shortlist.

currency.description: Currency all declared figures are in.

homes.description: Declared homes: {name, listing_source, fetch_date, status, ruled_out_reason, asking_price, monthly_housing_payment, monthly_property_tax, monthly_utilities_estimate, monthly_condo_or_hoa_fees, declared_monthly_carrying_cost, open_questions, meets_criteria}.

expect.notes: All fields present and valid. Hand-computed: Home A monthly carrying cost = 2500 + 300 + 200 + 0 = 3000, declared 3000 matches; total/lowest/highest = 3000.000000, spread 0.000000; asking 550000 <= ceiling 600000 so within budget (count 1, any true); coverage 1/1 = 1.000000.
